summary: Restrict controller log directories on RPM hosts: `/var/log/nginx` mode 770 owned `nginx:root`, `/var/log/tower` 770 owned `awx:awx`, and `/var/log/supervisor/` 770 owned `root:root`.
questions: What permissions should controller log directories have?
Who should own /var/log/nginx on automation controller?

answer_card.title: Controller log directory permissions (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
chmod 770 /var/log/nginx       && chown nginx:root /var/log/nginx
chmod 770 /var/log/tower       && chown awx:awx    /var/log/tower
chmod 770 /var/log/supervisor/ && chown root:root  /var/log/supervisor/
```
Run on each automation controller host.
